highlights: Movement keys, Jump, Hotbar slots, and Open Chat now use the same key-capture widget as hotkeys
Fixed Space key not being capturable in keybind fields
Editor hints and tooltips update live as you change keybinds
Fixed ENOTEMPTY download error when updating
HUD now shows at startup even without Minecraft open
HUD falls back to the built-in AHK renderer if the Electron HUD fails to launch
Updated launcher is saved under its versioned filename (EchoMacro-1.0.3.exe) instead of overwriting EchoMacro.exe
Movement keys, Jump, and Open Chat now use the same key-capture widget as hotkeys
Fixed 'ENOTEMPTY: directory not empty' error when downloading updates
HUD falls back to the built-in renderer if the Electron HUD process fails to launch
Hints in the config editor now reflect your current keybinds
Fixed incorrect default hotkey hints (editor was showing F6/F5 instead of Alt+C/Alt+D)
Hotkey tooltips now consistently show Alt+<key> matching the AHK binding
